officialRevision: Usage and limits for Cloud Firestore

limits.officialText: Maximum number of databases per project: 100
limits.notes: Exact once multi-database management is implemented.

limits.officialText: Maximum number of CMEK-enabled databases per project: default 0, allowlist / support dependent
limits.notes: Not applicable to a local test daemon in 1.0; profile when the management API exists.

limits.officialText: Constraints on collection IDs: valid UTF-8 characters, no longer than 1,500 bytes, cannot contain a forward slash (/), cannot solely consist of a single period (.) or double periods (..), cannot match the regular expression __.*__
limits.notes: Implemented by fireemu_core_types::ids::CollectionId. Local hardening: NUL and other control characters are rejected (INTENTIONAL_STRICTER).

limits.officialText: Maximum depth of subcollections: 100
limits.notes: Enforced by fireemu_core_firestore::path::DocumentPath constructors; boundary regression coverage in tests/mutants.rs.

limits.officialText: Constraints on document IDs: valid UTF-8 characters, no longer than 1,500 bytes, cannot contain a forward slash (/), cannot solely consist of a single period (.) or double periods (..), cannot match the regular expression __.*__
limits.notes: Implemented by fireemu_core_types::ids::DocumentId. Local hardening: NUL and other control characters are rejected (INTENTIONAL_STRICTER).

limits.officialText: Maximum size of a document name: 6 KiB
limits.notes: Measured on the UTF-8 bytes of the protocol resource name and enforced by fireemu_core_firestore::path::DocumentPath constructors.

limits.officialText: Maximum size for a document: 1 MiB (1,048,576 bytes)
limits.notes: Uses the official storage-size formula (spec 8.10.5). Enforced on every write that produces a document (fireemu_core_firestore::store::validate_document).

limits.officialText: Constraints on field names: valid UTF-8 characters, cannot match the regular expression __.*__, maximum size of a field name 1,500 bytes
limits.notes: Validated on every stored write, including nested maps and maps inside arrays. The query pseudo-field __name__ is rejected as a stored name. Local hardening also rejects control characters.

limits.officialText: Maximum size of a field path: 1,500 bytes
limits.notes: Measured on the canonical field path representation.

limits.officialText: Maximum size of a field value: 1 MiB - 89 bytes (1,048,487 bytes)
limits.notes: String and bytes payloads are limited to 1,048,487 bytes on every stored write, including nested values. The string boundary was verified against production on 2026-09-07. Aggregate value accounting remains unverified, so this entry does not yet claim full implementation.

limits.officialText: Maximum depth of fields in a map or array: 20
limits.notes: Each map or array level adds one. Enforced on every write that produces a document (fireemu_core_firestore::store::validate_document).

limits.officialText: Maximum API request size: 10 MiB
limits.notes: Measured on the message payload before protocol decode.

limits.officialText: Maximum time a transaction can run: 270 seconds
limits.notes: Enforced on the virtual clock: a transaction older than the budget is finished and every later use of it is INVALID_ARGUMENT (fireemu_core_firestore::store::FirestoreState::touch_transaction).

limits.officialText: Maximum idle time for a transaction: 60 seconds
limits.notes: The idle deadline is refreshed on every transaction activity; enforced on the virtual clock (fireemu_core_firestore::store::FirestoreState::touch_transaction).

limits.officialText: Maximum number of field transformations that can be performed on a single document in a Commit operation or in a transaction: 500
limits.notes: Enforced per commit, summed over every write that targets the same document (fireemu_core_firestore::store::FirestoreState::commit).

limits.officialText: Maximum number of composite indexes for a database: 200 (billing disabled), 1,000 (billing enabled); support may raise the limit
limits.notes: Configuration loading enforces 200 entries for the supported billing-disabled plan. Billing-enabled profiles and raised limits remain unsupported.

limits.officialText: Maximum number of single-field configurations for a database: 200 (billing disabled), 1,000 (billing enabled)
limits.notes: Configuration loading enforces 200 entries for the supported billing-disabled plan. Billing-enabled profiles and raised limits remain unsupported.

limits.officialText: Maximum number of index entries for each document: 40,000
limits.notes: Automatic and configured composite entries are accounted before atomic write/import publication, including inherited field overrides. Indexed values are capped at 1,500 bytes for storage accounting.

limits.officialText: Maximum number of fields in a composite index: 100
limits.notes: Index configuration loading rejects more than 100 fields and more than one array field.

limits.officialText: Maximum size of an index entry: 7.5 KiB
limits.notes: Automatic and configured composite entries are accounted before atomic write/import publication, including inherited field overrides. Indexed values are capped at 1,500 bytes for storage accounting.

limits.officialText: Maximum sum of the sizes of a document's index entries: 8 MiB
limits.notes: Automatic and configured composite entries are accounted before atomic write/import publication, including inherited field overrides. Indexed values are capped at 1,500 bytes for storage accounting.

limits.officialText: Maximum size of an indexed field value: 1,500 bytes; values over 1,500 bytes are truncated in the index
limits.notes: Production truncates the indexed representation; do not replace with a plain rejection.

limits.officialText: Maximum number of export and import requests for a project allowed per minute: 20
limits.notes: Sliding window, not token bucket, once the API exists.

limits.officialText: Maximum number of concurrent exports and imports: 50
Maximum number of collection ID filters for export and import requests: 100
Free quota, stored data: 1 GiB
limits.notes: Free tier applies to one database per project; observed only by default.

limits.officialText: Free quota, document reads: 50,000 per day
limits.notes: Daily reset at Pacific-time midnight via the timezone adapter.

limits.officialText: Free quota, document writes: 20,000 per day
Free quota, document deletes: 20,000 per day
Free quota, outbound data transfer: 10 GiB per month
